header: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: Apple App Store PRODUCT PAGE HEADER for Pricemori, a private manual price journal whose purpose is recording grocery prices and exploring price-history charts. Create a refined, restrained editorial still-life artwork, very wide landscape 21:9, ideally 3840 by 1646 pixels. Opaque background. A single landscape paper chart card with a thin graphite price-history line and six discrete observation dots, the final dot deep teal #0F766E. The line gently goes up, down, then up without an arrowhead, like actual observed prices rather than an investment forecast. A small blank paper price tag with a punched hole rests partly beside the chart, connecting to everyday price logging. Photoreal matte paper and graphite, subtle tactile detail, soft natural studio shadows, almost top-down view. Cool pale grey #F4F4F3 background, off-white card, charcoal fine lines, very limited teal accent. No warm orange cast. All meaningful objects must fit within the CENTRAL 50 percent of image width and central 65 percent of image height, with generous empty grey space on all edges so responsive cropping cannot damage the message. Sophisticated minimal iOS utility brand art; calm, crisp, beautiful, not a generic fintech ad. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO currency signs, NO logo or wordmark, NO phone/device mockups, NO invented UI, NO barcode, NO coins, NO gradients or glossy glass, NO upward arrow, NO watermark. The entire image must be finished edge-to-edge artwork, no frame around the canvas.
search: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: dedicated Apple App Store SEARCH RESULT artwork for Pricemori, a private manual price journal focused on price history and charts. Create a beautiful restrained editorial still-life image in landscape 3:2, ideally 3072 by 2048 pixels, opaque. Show one large off-white paper journal/chart card, slightly angled on a cool pale grey desk. The card contains a precise graphite line chart, with six visible circular observation points, subtle very pale grey horizontal guide lines, and one deep teal #0F766E final point. The line gently varies up and down, no arrowhead; it represents recorded grocery prices, not stocks. A single small blank paper price tag with punched hole touches the card near its lower side. Close composition that remains immediately legible at thumbnail size; main chart card and price tag centered and fully contained in the CENTRAL 70 percent of width and central 65 percent of height, with plenty of breathing room around all four edges for App Store crops. Photoreal matte paper, understated tactile texture, soft real studio lighting, charcoal and pale greys with one restrained teal accent. Modern, minimal and confident; no warm orange/beige cast, no dramatic perspective. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO currency signs, NO logo/wordmark, NO phone or device mockup, NO fake app UI, NO barcodes, NO coins, NO glowing/glass objects, NO upward arrows, NO rainbow colors, NO watermark. Full edge-to-edge composition.
